precipitation_source.citation: Huffman, G. J., Stocker, E. F., Bolvin, D. T., Nelkin, E. J., and Tan, J. (2023). GPM IMERG Final Precipitation L3 1 month 0.1 degree x 0.1 degree V07. NASA GES DISC. https://doi.org/10.5067/GPM/IMERG/3B-MONTH/07

reference_method: Independent scalar reads at saved global cell indices; math.fsum of precipitation depth times polygon-cell intersection area, normalized by valid area. Calendar duration verified from native time bounds.
quality_index_policy: diagnostic only; not a precipitation rejection mask
area_method: WGS84 geodesic polygon-cell intersection area; edges densified to 0.001 degrees; fixed INEGI MG2024 boundaries
